description: This file defines an Angular HTTP interceptor class 'EntityConflictInterceptor' that handles HTTP conflict errors, specifically 409 Conflict responses, by opening a dialog to resolve entity version conflicts.

classes.name: EntityConflictInterceptor
classes.description: An Angular HTTP interceptor that manages conflict errors for versioned entities, prompting user dialogs for conflict resolution.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Intercepts HTTP requests, handles conflict errors (status 409) by invoking conflict resolution dialog.

methods.name: handleConflictError
methods.description: Handles conflict errors by opening a dialog and processing user response to resolve version conflicts.

methods.name: updateRequestVersion
methods.description: Creates a clone of the request with the version set to null for conflict resolution.

methods.name: isVersionedEntity
methods.description: Checks if the entity is versioned based on its ID or rule chain ID.

methods.name: openConflictDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog component to resolve entity conflict and returns user decision.
